description: NJLBA training deck, previous-format specimen, slide 5. The final ZN terminator is missing. The canonicalized fixture appends CR and increases its declared length by one. The observed v04 DDA value B is preserved as opaque. Nine separate 2019 MVC interim samples corroborate this issuer value. Its meaning is unconfirmed. Source DCB and DCD are padded to 20 and 8 bytes.

provenance.verifiedBy: ZXing-C++ and Apple Vision agreed on the original 487 bytes. Compared the public training specimen with its printed dummy face and confirmed the historical compliance byte in nine MVC printout examples on pages 2 through 10 of its 2019 advisory.
